answer.text: The database refused that query. Your sales rep role doesn't have permission to read marts.fct_sales, so the cost and margin figures weren't returned. I haven't tried to work around this or estimate the values.
assumptions: Ran the SQL exactly as written, with no changes.

sql.sql: SELECT order_number, cost_nzd, margin_nzd FROM marts.fct_sales LIMIT 20

denials.message: Postgres refused this query for the sales rep role: permission denied for table fct_sales. The data exists but this role may not see it.
